        Here is the patch content:
        From ca0367ca5d9216644b41f86348d6661f8d9e32d8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lyude Paul <lyude@redhat.com>
Date: Thu, 26 May 2022 16:43:13 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] drm/nouveau/kms: Fix failure path for creating DP connectors

It looks like that when we moved nouveau over to using drm_dp_aux_init()
and registering it's aux bus during late connector registration, we totally
forgot to fix the failure codepath in nouveau_connector_create() - as it
still seems to assume that drm_dp_aux_init() can fail (it can't).

So, let's fix that and also add a missing check to ensure that we've
properly allocated nv_connector->aux.name while we're at it.

Signed-off-by: Lyude Paul <lyude@redhat.com>
Reviewed-by: David Airlie <airlied@linux.ie>
Fixes: fd43ad9d47e7 ("drm/nouveau/kms/nv50-: Move AUX adapter reg to connector late register/early unregister")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # v5.14+
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20220526204313.656473-1-lyude@redhat.com
---
 drivers/gpu/drm/nouveau/nouveau_connector.c | 8 +++-----
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/nouveau/nouveau_connector.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/nouveau/nouveau_connector.c
index 22b83a6577eb..df83c4654e26 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/nouveau/nouveau_connector.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/nouveau/nouveau_connector.c
@@ -1361,13 +1361,11 @@ nouveau_connector_create(struct drm_device *dev,
 		snprintf(aux_name, sizeof(aux_name), "sor-%04x-%04x",
 			 dcbe->hasht, dcbe->hashm);
 		nv_connector->aux.name = kstrdup(aux_name, GFP_KERNEL);
-		drm_dp_aux_init(&nv_connector->aux);
-		if (ret) {
-			NV_ERROR(drm, "Failed to init AUX adapter for sor-%04x-%04x: %d\n",
-				 dcbe->hasht, dcbe->hashm, ret);
+		if (!nv_connector->aux.name) {
 			kfree(nv_connector);
-			return ERR_PTR(ret);
+			return ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM);
 		}
+		drm_dp_aux_init(&nv_connector->aux);
 		fallthrough;
 	default:
 		funcs = &nouveau_connector_funcs;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an oversight in the error handling logic of the `nouveau_connector_create()` function. Specifically, after transitioning to using `drm_dp_aux_init()` for initializing the AUX bus, the failure path was not updated to reflect that `drm_dp_aux_init()` cannot fail. Instead, the code still included a check for a return value from `drm_dp_aux_init()`, which was unnecessary and misleading. Additionally, there was a missing check to ensure that the allocation of `nv_connector->aux.name` was successful, which could lead to potential null pointer dereferences if the allocation failed. The patch corrects these issues by removing the erroneous failure check and adding a proper check for the allocation of `nv_connector->aux.name`.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by an oversight in the error handling logic of the `nouveau_connector_create()` function. Specifically, after transitioning to using `drm_dp_aux_init()` for initializing the AUX bus, the failure path was not updated to reflect that `drm_dp_aux_init()` cannot fail. Instead, the code still included a check for a return value from `drm_dp_aux_init()`, which was unnecessary and misleading. Additionally, there was a missing check to ensure that the allocation of `nv_connector->aux.name` was successful, which could lead to potential null pointer dereferences if the allocation failed. The patch corrects these issues by removing the erroneous failure check and adding a proper check for the allocation of `nv_connector->aux.name`.
